newsitem.title: JAPAN: NEC forms Russian venture for switching equipment.
newsitem.headline: NEC forms Russian venture for switching equipment.

text.p: NEC Corp, Mitsui & Co Ltd and Sumitomo Corp have set up a joint venture with a Russian partner to produce digital switching equipment in Russia, NEC said on Wednesday.

The venture, capitalised at $6.1 million, is 45 percent owned by NEC, 10 percent each by trading houses Mitsui and Sumitomo, and 35 percent by a Russian regional telephone company, an NEC spokesman said.
The venture will start operations within the next one or two years and will eventually produce enough digital switching equipment annually to produce a total of 500,000 circuits, he said.
The initial sales target will be an annual 10 billion yen, the NEC spokesman said.
